units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 2:3">Kil. II, 3</cite> <he>עד שתַּתְלִיעַ</he> until the seed in the ground begins to rot; Y. ib. 27ᵈ top <he>עד כמה היא מַתְלַעַת וכ׳</he> R. S. to Kil. l. c. (ed. <he>מזרעת</he>, corr. acc.) how long does it take to rot? Three days in moist ground &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:8:5">Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ</cite> top <he>והִתְלִיעוּ תאינותיו</he> (not <he>תיה …</he>) and his figs (on the tree) became wormy (or rotten).
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:6">Cant. R. to IV, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 47:6">Gen. R. s. 47</cite> <he>התליעו</he> they decayed.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 52a">B. Kam. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>שה׳ מתוכו</he> when the board that covered the pit rotted from the inside; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to remove the wormy parts from; to sort wood.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Middot 2:5">Midd. II, 5</cite> <he>ששם … מַתְלִיעִים את העצים</he> for there the priests … sorted the wood for the altar.

senses.gloss: to drive vermin off. Y. Shebi. II, 33ᵈ מְתַלְּעִין, v. זָהַם. Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ top המעשן המְתַלֵּעַ וכ׳ he who fumigates plants, or smears them with rancid oil to keep the worms off &c.—Part. pass. מְתוּלָּע; f. מְתוּלַּעַת; pl. מְתוּלָּעִים, מְתוּלָּעִין; מְתוּלָּעוֹת wormy.
units: B. Bath. VI, 2 (93ᵇ) תאנים מקבל … מת׳ וכ׳ if one buys figs, he must accept ten wormy ones for each hundred; (Y. ed. מַתְלִיעוֹת Hif., v. supra).—[

senses.gloss: (b. h.) to dye scarlet; to clothe in scarlet.—V. תּוֹלֵעָה.]
